answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in shared escrow before it may trade, so the market has one guarded inlet instead of a free haven for fake identities. The stake is slashed on proven fraud, so an attacker spinning up a thousand clones must pay a thousand times and the loss scales with attack size. Honest agents recover their stake over time, keeping the horizon open for newcomers while making large-scale sybil farming unprofitable.
